newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Northwest offers hub improvements in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Northwest offers hub improvements in U.S..

text.p: HONG KONG, Nov 26 - Northwest Airlines said passengers from Hong Kong and Asia travelling via its Minneapolis hub are now able to enjoy faster, more convenient connections at the new international arrivals facility there.
The $30 million development next to Northwest's domestic gates has sixteen immigration desks, can accomodate 800 passengers an hour and offers multi-lingual staff for Asian travellers.
Tokyo is connected to Minneapolis by daily Northwest flights. A new three times a week service to Osaka is due to begin next spring, the airlines said. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706
